task.description:
REWORK of bench env setup. The previous fix (adding .env reading to bench.zig) still has a residual problem: zig build bench exits with code 1 due to BENCHMARK_SETUP_ERROR referencing source=BPM_DB_URL, even though all NFR benchmarks pass (p99_read=0.935ms, p99_write=2.222ms, throughput=86886eps, replay=37ms).

Investigate tests/bench/bench.zig and find why the setup error is triggered after the .env fix. The .env file reading might not be working correctly for BPM_DB_URL. Check:
1. How resolveDbUrl works
2. Whether BPM_DB_URL is actually read from .env
3. Why the function still reports MissingDbUrl after .env fix

Fix so that zig build bench exits 0 cleanly with all NFRs passing.
